stemMd: A review board approves a trial only if participants can withdraw. Trials with a favorable risk assessment and withdrawal rights are approved unless they lack independent monitoring. Which trial is guaranteed approval?

options.label: A
options.textMd: One with independent monitoring but no withdrawal rights.

options.label: B
options.textMd: One with withdrawal rights but no favorable risk assessment.

options.label: C
options.textMd: One with a favorable risk assessment, withdrawal rights, and independent monitoring.

options.label: D
options.textMd: One with favorable risk assessment but no independent monitoring.

options.label: E
options.textMd: One whose sponsor promises favorable results.

explanationMd: The guarantee combines a favorable assessment and withdrawal rights, subject to independent monitoring. All are present in the keyed case. Approval cannot be inferred merely from one desirable feature.

distractorRationale.e: A promise of results satisfies none of the relevant safeguards.
distractorRationale.a: Monitoring does not replace the necessary right to withdraw.
